verdict.rationale: Clerky's startup product page says founders can issue safes or convertible notes from its legal dashboard. Its attorney docs mention managing safes and convertible notes, and the software lets users customize key terms of template-based paperwork rather than drafting from scratch. A community user confirms a post-incorporation Fundraising package. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that the SAFE/note templates use standard terms (e.g. YC-standard), no SAFE-specific documentation of the e-signature flow (signing on Clerky is only shown for formations), and no independent hands-on report of issuing a SAFE or note.
